verdicts.reason: HOL4 defines RESULT via Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition (new_specification), saving only ∀t. RESULT (Result t) = t and leaving RESULT (Clash t) completely unconstrained. In Lean, RESULT transparently defines the .Clash t branch as t, so Lean proves RESULT (Clash 0) = 0 by reduction, an equation HOL4's saved theorems leave open. This is a genuine V-C conservativity violation.

HOL4 defines CLASH via Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition (new_specification), saving only ∀t. CLASH (Clash t) = t and leaving CLASH (Result t) completely unconstrained. In Lean, CLASH transparently defines the .Result t branch as t, so Lean proves CLASH (Result 0) = 0 by reduction, an equation HOL4's saved theorems leave open. This is a genuine V-C conservativity violation.
